items.whatItShows: Macro of a single soap bubble on pure black, lit from the right so it reads as a half-lit planet with marbled swirling film bands.
items.subjectRegion: Right-of-centre half disc: visible lit area spans roughly x 28-73%, y 12-90%; brightest along the right limb (x 60-73%), fading to nothing at about x 28%. Left half of the sphere is invisible.
items.negativeSpace: Pure black everywhere outside the lit half: whole left 28% of the frame, the right 27%, a top band of about 12% and a bottom band of about 10%. Left side is the largest clean text area.
items.depthStructure: Single object on a void. One curved surface (sphere bulging toward camera, nearest at about x 55%, y 50%, receding to the right limb) against an infinitely distant black background. No foreground or middle layers; depth separation is binary (sphere versus void) plus smooth spherical curvature.
items.tonalNotes: About 76% of pixels near black. Highlights are soft light grey on the right limb with one small specular white streak near x 50%, y 57%. Dark veins on the left/centre of the bubble. Gradual terminator on the left, crisp edge on the right.
items.cropAdvice: Square; can be cropped to portrait around x 25-78%. For a wide banner keep the bubble right and let black extend left (extend canvas with black, background is true black).

items.whatItShows: Macro of a bubble sphere on pure black, lit from the right, with heavy marbled swirls and deep black veins; looks like a dark planet.
items.subjectRegion: Disc occupies roughly x 20-73%, y 9-95%; crisp right limb at x 73%, left side fades into black around x 20-28%. Brightest marbling in the centre-right (x 45-70%, y 35-80%); a smoother grey area at left-centre (x 25-45%, y 35-75%).
items.negativeSpace: Pure black: right 27% of the frame (full height), left 20%, top-left corner down to about y 30%, and a thin band at top and bottom. Right column is the cleanest area for text.
items.depthStructure: Single sphere against a black void; no other layers. Sphere surface curves from nearest point around frame centre back to the limb; the upper-left quarter of the sphere sinks into shadow. Depth separation is sphere versus void only.
items.tonalNotes: About 75% near black, almost no pure white; highlights are mid-to-light grey, so it benefits from a levels lift. Black veins inside the bubble merge with the background along the right limb in places, which makes the edge look slightly ragged there.
items.cropAdvice: 8008 px square allows tight crops into the marbling (e.g. x 40-72%, y 35-85%) at full screen resolution. Small blemishes on the limb at top (x 43%, y 11%) and bottom-left (x 27%, y 92%).

items.whatItShows: Crown of a soap bubble emerging from darkness, its top band pocked with round black holes between bright swirled film; shallow depth of field.
items.subjectRegion: Arc across the lower half: apex about x 50%, y 46%, falling to y 75% at the left edge and y 80% at the right edge. Sharp detail only in a band about y 47-62%; below that is blurred.

items.tonalNotes: Low key, mean level very dark. Brightest at the left end of the arc (x 0-30%, y 55-75%) and the right edge. Holes are true black with bright rims.
items.cropAdvice: 16:9. Crop off the bottom 15-20% to drop the muddiest blur; keeps the black top for text.

items.reason: Licence confirmed at source; real macro photograph, no watermark. Crisp cell-wall network, good in grayscale; busy edge to edge with no quiet area.
items.whatItShows: Macro of soap froth filling the frame: a network of thin bright polyhedral cell walls and junctions over a dark ground, with reflections inside the films.
items.subjectRegion: All-over pattern, no single subject. Largest cells at left-centre (x 0-35%, y 45-95%) and right-centre (x 65-92%, y 38-80%); brightest reflections at x 45-55%, y 22-30% and x 68-78%, y 40-48%.
items.negativeSpace: None that is clean. Relatively dark zones: top-left corner (x 0-15%, y 0-20%), centre (x 40-65%, y 30-60%) and the far top-right. Text needs a scrim.
items.depthStructure: Several overlapping translucent layers: sharp front cell walls, softer second and third layers of cells seen through them, dark ground behind. Depth is real but shallow and tangled; no clean separation between planes.
items.tonalNotes: Thin bright lines on dark; 42% near black, few true whites. Mid-grey smeared reflections in the lower left and right-middle.
items.cropAdvice: 16:9; any sub-crop works as texture. Best used as a textured background or transition rather than behind body text.

items.whatItShows: x250 photomicrograph of a soap bubble surface: dozens of ringed circular islands of thicker film floating in jet-black ultra-thin film, with a bright banded region down the left.
items.subjectRegion: All-over field. Bright continuous film mass at the left (x 0-28%, full height, bounded by a curved edge bulging right). Largest islands in the centre-left (x 28-60%, y 12-72%); smaller scattered discs and dots across the right half.
items.negativeSpace: Jet black between the islands; largest clear patches at top centre-right (x 60-85%, y 0-10%) and the right-centre (x 60-70%, y 25-45%), all small. No area large enough for a text block without overlapping discs.
items.depthStructure: Physically flat film photographed square-on; no real depth. A depth model will likely invent relief from the rings (islands as raised discs, black film as holes), which suits the subject but is not true geometry.
items.tonalNotes: Hard graphic contrast: 50% true black, discs in flat mid grey with white rings and near-white centres. Bright mottled whites at the left edge. Edges are slightly soft at full size (microscope optics), fine at screen scale.
items.cropAdvice: 3:2. Right half alone (x 50-100%) is a sparser, starfield-like crop; left third is the brightest.

items.whatItShows: Close-up of a soap film lit from above: a large dark thin-film region with pale translucent discs on the left, divided by a sharp curved boundary from bright banded interference rings on the right.
items.subjectRegion: Curved boundary runs from (x 58%, y 0%) bulging right to (x 69%, y 45%) and back to (x 62%, y 100%). Bright banded region fills x 62-100%, with a large concentric-ring target at x 72-88%, y 28-58%. Dark region with scattered grey discs fills x 0-62%.
items.negativeSpace: Left 60% is dark and quiet (dark grey with soft translucent discs of varying size); the calmest patches are x 12-32%, y 0-40% and x 8-25%, y 50-75%. Good for light text on the left.
items.depthStructure: Physically flat film seen square-on; no true depth. Two tonal zones (dark thin film, bright thick film) that a depth model may separate into two planes along the curved boundary.
items.tonalNotes: Left side dark grey (not pure black) with mid-grey discs; right side light grey to white with thin black contour lines. 46% near black, 8% bright. A few dust specks.
items.cropAdvice: 3:2. Mirror horizontally if the text needs to sit on the right. Right third alone makes an abstract contour-map crop.

items.whatItShows: A cluster of joined soap bubbles sitting on a wet surface against pure black, every cell wall and junction traced as a thin bright line.
items.subjectRegion: Mound in the lower centre-right: x 18-85%, y 22-97%. Tallest at x 55-80% (top at y 22%); the left part is lower (top at about y 45%). Base with small froth and a wet reflective surface along y 85-100%.
items.negativeSpace: Pure black: top 22% full width, left 18% full height, right 15% full height. Upper-left quadrant is the largest clean area.
items.depthStructure: Front cells (lower left and centre, sharp bright outlines) overlap larger bubbles behind and to the upper right (fainter outlines), all on a wet base plane in the immediate foreground at the bottom; black void behind. Real layered depth, but the films are transparent, so a depth model will mostly see the outlines.
items.tonalNotes: Almost pure line-art in grayscale: white hairline walls and small specular highlights on black, mean level very low. Brightest froth at the base (x 25-30%, y 85-90% and x 65-78%, y 82-90%).
items.cropAdvice: 3:2. Crop to x 15-88% for a tighter cluster. As a point cloud the thin lines will be sparse; needs dense sampling of bright pixels.
